The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] fought a '''war''' with the [[Ereesi/Legends|Ereesi]] [[Species/Legends|species]] circa [[4200 BBY]] to protect the [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] species, who were being targeted by the Ereesi for [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]]. In the lead-up to the war, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argazda/Legends|Argazda]] lay beyond the borders of the Republic. Thus the Argazdans petitioned for membership in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government to legitimate a Republic intervention. Argazda and the neighboring [[Realspace/Legends|space]] were admitted to the Republic as the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]], and Republic forces stopped the Ereesi's despoliation of Argazda. In the aftermath of the war, the Argazdans came to despise outsiders, whom they viewed as immoral. The Republic departed the planet once they deemed the Argazdans capable of handling their own affairs.<ref name="EA ">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
